lawyer: Md. Nowab Ali, Advocate — For the Petitioner.
parties:
Amanat Traders  ----- Petitioner
Vs.
Artha Rin Adalat  ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 3. Mr. Nawab Ali, in support of this petition, seriously canvassed before us that as there was no cause of action for filing the suit the order refusing to reject the plaint has been passed without lawful authority. Mr. Nawab Ali submits that section 7 of the Artha Rin Adalat Act, 1990 provides for appeal from the judgment or decree. He says that no appeal lies from an interim order of the said court. Although so far as an ad interim or interlocutory order made by the said court is concerned no appeal lies but in view of section 5 (4) of the Act the petitioner is not debarred to move an application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure inasmuch as by sub-section (4) of section 5 of that Act provision of the Code of Civil Procedure had been made applicable and proviso to sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Artha Rin Adalat Act. 1990 does not by explicit language debar the petitioner to move a revisional application to this Division under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
